lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn2B4Ir4 (MnB2Ir2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives each Ir center 9 geometric neighbors (4 B, 5 Mn), each B center 9 neighbors (2 B, 3 Ir, 4 Mn), and each Mn center 14 neighbors (4 B, 10 Ir), with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.34 to 2.82 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ir- and B-centered polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among B-centered polyhedra.
